purpose: Finite missing authority set for the first post-210 Ma interval; requirements are not values or authorization.

parameters.quantity: Per-plate initial angular velocity or finite-rotation increment, with units, sign convention, reference plate/frame and covariance/support
parameters.authority_class: LITERATURE_PRIOR plus MODEL_CALIBRATION or explicitly authorized ENSEMBLE_PARAMETER
parameters.cannot_assume: zero motion, Earth path, A1 path, or random walk

parameters.quantity: Maximum time validity of each motion segment and rule for when its parameters may change
Causal rule and bounded rate/acceleration change from state, forcing or event; include units, update rule and uncertainty
parameters.authority_class: MODEL_CALIBRATION; ENSEMBLE_PARAMETER only after structure and distribution authorized

parameters.quantity: Time-valid spherical vector/topological partition and boundary geometry with mapping from current plate IDs and support
parameters.current: MISSING; current 1-degree plate labels are coarse support
parameters.authority_class: AUTHORIAL_CONSTRAINT or independently governed geometric construction with explicit support
parameters.cannot_assume: raster cell edges are exact plate boundaries

parameters.quantity: Supported weak-zone/suture geometry, mechanical meaning, strength scale and uncertainty, or explicit rule that such state is unavailable
parameters.needed: FIRST_INTERVAL because breakup eligibility may be immediate
parameters.current: MISSING; province/suture design labels are not mechanical weakness
parameters.authority_class: LITERATURE_PRIOR plus MODEL_CALIBRATION / explicit authorial constraints

parameters.quantity: Initial extensional forcing representation, units, spatial support, source and time dependence
parameters.authority_class: MODEL_CALIBRATION; optional Deep coupling requires separate authority

parameters.quantity: Explicit eligibility function combining supported weakness and forcing, thresholds/units, persistence and unknown handling
State/driver-conditioned onset rule (deterministic or governed stochastic hazard), temporal semantics and uncertainty
parameters.authority_class: LITERATURE_PRIOR + MODEL_CALIBRATION; seeded stochastic only with explicit distribution authority

parameters.quantity: Mapping from mature event geometry to boundary, child plate lineage and topology partition; minimum fragment scale if used
parameters.needed: FIRST_INTERVAL if initiation can occur; otherwise before first eligible split

parameters.quantity: Deterministic evaluation contract for whether any rift/collision transition can become eligible during first interval, including unknown inputs
parameters.cannot_assume: defer event laws without proving event cannot activate

parameters.quantity: Maximum displacement per accepted step, topology/event tolerances, rejected-step/restart behavior and error criteria
For P01-P11 identify fixed/seeded/ensemble/model uncertainty, bounds/distribution if applicable, provenance and canonical realization policy
parameters.cannot_assume: unstated probability distributions or aesthetic trajectory selection

later_only_requirements.needed: Before evolving an initiated rift beyond initiation
Before assigning new oceanic crust/basin depth
Before a convergent/contact state can transition
Before attributing shoreline change to eustatic/climate sea level
Before erosion/sediment/relaxation; climate-dependent portion waits for climate authority
